verdict.rationale: SOSPortal is an online filing, ordering and search platform, so a built-in AI assistant is a plausible capability and the axis applies. None of the published pages mention any AI assistant, chatbot or task-delegation feature; they cover only filing, drafts, submissions tracking, payments and MFA. The filing host's robots.txt naming bans on AI agents concern external crawlers, not an in-product assistant, so they don't bear on this story.
